description: The sections an activity type's fields are grouped into. ONE row states everything a section is: which CRM Task Table field holds its rows, whose columns they are, whether a task may carry many of them, and which column addresses one. Every reader — the activity form, Smart Views, automation, the partner API — asks this table; the answer is never restated on a CRM Task Type Field row. Mirrors CRM Lead Section.

fields.label: Section Key
fields.description: The key a CRM Task Type Field names to say where its answer lands. Every field naming this section is routed by the row below.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading these fields are shown under, on the activity form and in a partner's error messages.

fields.label: Tab
fields.description: The form tab these sections are grouped into. Blank = the first tab.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Ascending within the tab: a lower number sits higher on the form.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: Optional JS condition showing this section only when relevant (native frappe-ui depends_on). A hidden section's fields are never required.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The doctype whose columns these fields are. Every field naming this section is resolved against it, so a field that is not one of its columns is refused.

fields.label: Child Table Field
fields.description: The Table field on CRM Task holding these rows, e.g. custom_engagement. Left blank the section IS the task row itself, and the target must then be CRM Task.

fields.label: Is Multi Row
fields.description: A task may carry many of these rows — a document per kind. Ticked, a write upserts the row named by the Row Key Field and leaves every other row untouched; unticked, the one row is merged onto.

fields.label: Row Key Field
fields.description: The column identifying one row, e.g. document_kind. Required when multi-row: it is the address a write is applied at, and the key every consumer picks the latest row by. On a key-value section it is the column carrying the declared field a row answers.

fields.label: Is Key Value
fields.description: One row per declared field, where a CRM Task Type Field's Fieldname addresses a ROW rather than naming a column. Ticked, the Row Key Field carries that fieldname and the Value Field carries the answer, so a new activity field is a declaration row and never a schema change. Mutually exclusive with Multi Row.

fields.label: Value Field
fields.description: The column holding a key-value row's answer, e.g. value. Required when key-value; every consumer reads the answer through it.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: The column holding what a key-value row is CALLED, where the row is the only thing that knows. An activity field is declared on CRM Task Type Field, which already carries its label, so a task section leaves this blank rather than storing a second copy.

fields.label: Question Field
fields.description: The column holding the raw key a key-value row's identity was derived from, e.g. fieldname. Required when key-value: it is what a row says it was addressed by.

name: CRM Task Section
